From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@legacybank.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: LegacyBank discovery recap — on‑prem / air‑gapped questions

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can scope an on‑prem air‑gapped deployment correctly: 

1) Deployment mode: you confirmed the preference is a fully air‑gapped on‑prem install for prod (no outbound internet access), with a cloud control plane only for billing/contracting. Correct?

2) Hardware baseline: you mentioned 8x A100 GPUs initially for POC, with potential scale to 32 GPUs across two data centers for prod. Can you confirm host type (NVIDIA A100 40GB vs 80GB), whether you need multi‑instance GPU sharing, and whether you have a preferred vendor (Dell/HP/HPE)?

3) Upgrades & offline ops: important to understand your maintenance windows and whether you can accept scheduled upgrade packages (air‑gapped bundles we provide) vs. a requirement for on‑site engineer assistance. Also: who owns kernel/OS patching for nodes?

4) Networking & certs: we need your network topology, firewall/IP allowlist for the management plane (if any), and the KMS/HSM approach for key management (customer‑managed KMS vs Redwood‑managed).

Next steps I propose: 
- You send the hardware/vendor details + network topology template (I attached our template)
- We schedule a technical workshop with our infra SEs (Dev Patel and Vivek Kulkarni) next week to walk through offline upgrade flows and air‑gap install process

Attachments: network‑topology‑template.xlsx (template), redwood‑onprem‑hw‑checklist.pdf (hw checklist)

If that all sounds right I can book the workshop — proposed slots: Tue 16 Mar 10–11am PT or Wed 17 Mar 2–3pm PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: network-topology-template.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-onprem-hw-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — yes, that aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 
• GPUs: POC will use 8x A100 40GB (we have a mix in our inventory). Prod target is up to 32x A100 80GB but that depends on budgeting — we wanted you to size for both.
• Vendor: prefer Dell R750xd chassis (we have an existing agreement).
• Patching: infra team will manage OS/kernel patching; application/container upgrades need coordination. For air‑gapped upgrades we require a signed SOW for remote package transfer + MD5 checksums for all bundles.
• KMS: customer‑managed HSM via AWS CloudHSM in our DR region; on‑prem we have a Thales HSM for key storage.

I attached a preliminary inventory export — it's rough but should help. Also copying Procurement for contract/timing.

Hi all —

Thanks Samir — the inventory helps. Quick answers and proposed minimal config: 

1) POC baseline (supported):
- GPUs: A100 40GB supported for POC with single‑instance MPS. For production we recommend A100 80GB or equivalent (for KV cache and longer context models).
- OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (kernel 5.4+), we also support RHEL 8.6 (we'll produce RPMs).
- NVIDIA stack: CUDA 11.4+, cuDNN matching 8.x; NVIDIA driver 470+ for A100.

2) Offline / air‑gapped upgrades:
- We will provide signed upgrade bundles (tar.gz) with SHA256 checksums and detached GPG signatures. Legacy team provides a secure transfer medium (SFTP to an isolated host or physical UPS drive).
- Upgrade flow doc attached — includes precheck script, dry‑run mode, and rollback commands.
- For on‑site assistance: we can include a 2‑day remote runbook review + optional 1‑day on‑site assistance in SOW.

3) KMS / HSM integration:
- We support Thales HSM via PKCS#11 and can integrate with customer HSMs for key ops. For DR binding to CloudHSM, we'll use a separate key wrapping approach and maintain no plaintext keys in our control plane.

4) Next steps / workshop:
- Proposed workshop: Tue 16 Mar 10–11am PT — Dev + Vivek will run through install/upgrade slides and validate network rules.
- Deliverables before workshop: completed network topology template + inventory (Samir already provided a start).

Attachments: redwood-onprem-hw-checklist.pdf (detailed checklist), airgap-upgrade-flow.md (plain text)

I'll be available in the workshop slot — Vivek will cover HSM specifics.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Infra Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
